key_insight: The paper shows that disruption-driven supply chain capacity can be unlocked by combining ADMM-based distributed re-optimization with LLM-guided search over external providers.
engineering_relevance: This is relevant for resilient logistics platforms because it offers a practical way to find and integrate spare capacity without exposing proprietary network models.
method: Use ADMM to coordinate incumbent firms while keeping their models private.
Use residual capacity gaps to guide LLM-based retrieval and ranking of provider profiles.
Verify, screen by reduced cost, then warm-start re-optimization after promising offers are revealed.
evidence_signal: In 200 synthetic episodes, full-information opening recovered 24.6% of capacity-scarcity cost, and with 40 contacts the coordinated LLM approach captured 32.0% of that value versus 4.7% for undirected contact.
watch_item: The approach is only guaranteed optimal when every eligible offer is revealed at exact prices; incomplete or imprecise profile data makes it heuristic and the exact capacity covered by offers remains a key missing detail.
paper_title: Open Capacity Pooling in Agentic Supply Chains: Coordination-Directed LLM Discovery and Distributed Re-optimization
